<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier implemented using pipelining.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. 0 for reset, 1 for normal operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal controlling the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplicand input with 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Multiplier input with 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output with 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description></parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic"></logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Pipeline stages
        reg [7:0] mul_a_reg;
        reg [7:0] mul_b_reg;
        reg [7:0] temp [0:7];
        reg [15:0] sum [0:7];
        reg [15:0] mul_out_reg;
        reg mul_en_out_reg;

        // Pipeline control
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                mul_a_reg <= 8'b0;
                mul_b_reg <= 8'b0;
                mul_en_out_reg <= 1'b0;
                mul_out_reg <= 16'b0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) begin
                    temp[i] <= 8'b0;
                    sum[i] <= 16'b0;
                end
            end else begin
                if (mul_en_in) begin
                    mul_a_reg <= mul_a;
                    mul_b_reg <= mul_b;
                    mul_en_out_reg <= mul_en_in;
                end

                // Partial product generation
                for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) begin
                    temp[i] <= mul_a_reg & (mul_b_reg >>> i);
                end

                // Partial sum calculation
                for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) begin
                    sum[i] <= sum[i-1] + temp[i];
                end

                // Final product calculation
                mul_out_reg <= sum[7];
            end
        end

        // Output assignment
        assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg;
        assign mul_out = mul_out_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
